      Problem: Both regexes contain the backticked-filename pattern ` `[^`]+\.[[:alpha:]]+` `. This pattern matches any file name in backticks and treats it as an edit claim. This causes false positives when the editor merely mentions a file (e.g., "Reviewed `README.md`") without actually claiming to have changed it.; Transitions the PR into an `EDITOR_CHANGES_LOST` state when the editor correctly reports no changes but mentions a file name. This triggers unnecessary retries, admin alerts, and blocks auto-merge.
      Confidence: avg 5.0
